items.title: Jackie Williams interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995
items.q: So they got there, it was Joe Medlin the singer, and Major Holley came. They’re playing for Tiny Bradshaw... So finally we got it all together

ctx.x: What kind of dances were they doing at this point? What year was it?

Fifties. Late fifties. Medium fifties, you know. Yeah, medium fifties, late fifties around that time, going into the sixties. Well they were doing the Lindy, formal, like ballroom, they were doing mambos. The mambo was coming out. Then a lot of Latin and mambo and stuff like that. And calypso, they did calypso, jitterbug, swing-type dancing, ballroom dancing, and they always did some kind of creative things, you know. So I used to get a lot of gigs playing with some groups, local groups and I remember one time,…

living room and I was staying with her at the time.
